model.description: Fixed-denominator fidelity loss for the T3 Code Web to Lynx-for-Web to Lynxtron Native port.

points.label: First archived matched geometry
points.narrative: New Thread exposed a 216px focal geometry miss and complete content drift; Settings and the populated Sidebar were already structurally close.

points.label: Exact-owned Native readiness
points.narrative: Three isolated starts proved the main-owned transport, advancing sequence, canonical thread/model identity, and zero renderer errors.

points.label: Seven-state Browser matrix
points.narrative: The first dual-renderer matrix proved identity and readiness across 14 cells. It also exposed that green harness geometry baselines were not visual parity.

points.label: 39-state strict evidence matrix
points.narrative: Plan 11C expanded the denominator to 39 product states. Browser content coverage became broad, while Native evidence remained intentionally sparse and R5/R10 blockers stayed explicit.

points.label: First Native pixel baseline
points.narrative: A real Web/Native comparison measured 4.467 MAE and 5.86% significant-pixel share across the full 1280×820 frame.

points.label: Masked pixel residual convergence
points.narrative: After deterministic timer masking, full-frame residual fell to 1.1009 MAE and 1.2763% significant pixels; Composer, Sidebar, Header, and Transcript regions became independently measurable.

points.label: Four-state review interaction matrix
points.narrative: Four combinations of Sidebar and changed-files state passed exact-owned Native interaction and geometry checks; card-region SSIM improved from 0.7492 to 0.8758.

points.label: Model Picker fidelity closeout
points.narrative: Browser geometry reached zero panel delta; Native proved main transport, exact 360×346 panel geometry, real-tap dismissal, scrolling, search, favorites, and provider/model selection. Selected-state pixels remained explicitly pending.

points.label: Evidence archaeology reset
points.narrative: The product did not regress. Archaeology removed stale pixels and demoted pre-final5 claims, so current-head evidence confidence falls while historical observed residual remains intact.

referenceSystem.adaptation: T3 adds a fixed denominator, explicit evidence confidence, and a time/commit loss ledger.

policy: Evidence dates and code commits are separate fields.
Unknown cells retain maximum conservative loss.
Browser evidence never satisfies Native-only interaction or runtime cells.
Superseding stale pixels reduces confidence without rewriting historical product residual.
